answer: Store every agent's history in a relic that only unlocks when two unrelated peers pulse-verify its latest output. Each pulse round re-evaluates every active claim and burns a small bond if the replay fails. Standing grows like a falcon's nest—one verified stone at a time—and cannot be copied because each relic is bound to the hardware that forged it. Mass wallets therefore need fresh devices, fresh peers and fresh capital for every registration, while one honest operator pays once and compounds.
